legend: There is a matrix A of size x × y filled with integers. For every ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e87325918316c52884e4063f23cf77cfe475ee7c.png), ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b2547b0e9acdacd0f9e1ca13295a4cc301cde743.png) Ai, j = y(i - 1) + j. Obviously, every integer from [1..xy] occurs exactly once in this matrix.

You have traversed some path in this matrix. Your path can be described as a sequence of visited cells a1, a2, ..., an denoting that you started in the cell containing the number a1, then moved to the cell with the number a2, and so on.
From the cell located in i-th line and j-th column (we denote this cell as (i, j)) you can move into one of the following cells:

Notice that making a move requires you to go to an adjacent cell. It is not allowed to stay in the same cell. You don't know x and y exactly, but you have to find any possible values for these numbers such that you could start in the cell containing the integer a1, then move to the cell containing a2 (in one step), then move to the cell containing a3 (also in one step) and so on. Can you choose x and y so that they don't contradict with your sequence of moves?
input: The first line contains one integer number n (1 ≤ n ≤ 200000) — the number of cells you visited on your path (if some cell is visited twice, then it's listed twice).
The second line contains n integers a1, a2, ..., an (1 ≤ ai ≤ 109) — the integers in the cells on your path.
output: If all possible values of x and y such that 1 ≤ x, y ≤ 109 contradict with the information about your path, print NO.

Otherwise, print YES in the first line, and in the second line print the values x and y such that your path was possible with such number of lines and columns in the matrix. Remember that they must be positive integers not exceeding 109.

legend.ai: 有一个大小为 x × y 的矩阵 A，其中填有整数。对于每个 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e87325918316c52884e4063f23cf77cfe475ee7c.png)，有 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b2547b0e9acdacd0f9e1ca13295a4cc301cde743.png) Ai, j = y(i - 1) + j。显然，整数 [1..xy] 中的每个整数都恰好在该矩阵中出现一次。
你在这个矩阵中走过了一条路径。你的路径可以表示为一个访问过的单元格序列 a1, a2, ..., an，这表示你从包含数字 a1 的单元格出发，然后移动到包含数字 a2 的单元格，以此类推。
从位于第 i 行、第 j 列的单元格（记作 (i, j)）出发，你可以移动到以下单元格之一：
(i + 1, j) —— 仅当 i < x 时；
(i, j + 1) —— 仅当 j < y 时；
注意，进行一次移动要求你前往相邻的单元格。不允许停留在同一个单元格中。你并不知道 x 和 y 的确切值，但你必须为这两个数找到任意一组可能的值，使得你可以从包含整数 a1 的单元格出发，然后一步移动到包含 a2 的单元格，再一步移动到包含 a3 的单元格，依此类推。你能否选择 x 和 y，使它们与移动序列不矛盾？

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 200000），表示你在路径上访问过的单元格数量（如果某个单元格被访问了两次，那么它会被列出两次）。
第二行包含 n 个整数 a1, a2, ..., an（1 ≤ ai ≤ 109），表示路径上各个单元格中的整数。

output.ai: 如果所有满足 1 ≤ x, y ≤ 109 的 x 和 y 的可能取值都与关于路径的信息相矛盾，则输出 NO。
否则，在第一行输出 YES，并在第二行输出数值 x 和 y，使得在矩阵具有这样的行数和列数时，你的路径是可行的。请记住，它们必须是正整数且不超过 10^9。
